report.notes: Fixes R13-01 and both causes in the D7 diagnosis. (1) Field-label channel: snapshot.js builds labels only from textVisible text nodes of label[for], the wrapping label and aria-labelledby targets, sent as label_pieces; aria-label/name/id/placeholder are used only for the in-page sensitivity test; fields not shown have no label. perception.py pixel-checks label_pieces into shown_label; bridge._context_block uses shown_label only, otherwise a neutral '<type> field N' name (no name/id fallback). (2) Text-bound pixel check: onscreen.untangle drops overlapping drawn pieces with different text (counted overlapping_text) across text, selection, headings and labels; in page, covered() uses elementsFromPoint paint order (an ancestor painted above the text covers it), the background-colour rule applies to all text using the first opaque background below the text, SVG fill/fill-opacity/stroke is evaluated, and -webkit-mask-box-image/mask-border counts as masked. In test_a0_d10_pixel_checked_text.py, PIXEL_ONLY now lists only BLUR/PEN/BELOWFOLD, a new assertion requires the R13 payloads to be removed in page, and the no_ink minimum went from 9 to 2 because fewer pieces reach the pixel check; every assertion on what reaches the Brain is unchanged. Verified: all 6 new tests and both extended Chromium tests fail on a clean export of fcfb465 and pass after the change; tests/assist + tests/web: 2656 passed. Docs 03 section 4 and A0_QUALIFICATION (A0-AC8 row, L-A0-5, evidence row) updated with explicit correction notes. Remaining residual (documented): hidden text over drawn ink that is not page text (borders/images/canvas) passes unless an in-page rule catches it; thresholds verified only on headless Chromium at DPR 1. graphify-out/ files created by 'graphify update .' were deleted because they are outside the permitted paths.
